description: Google (official Vertex AI / Gemini API) — gemini-2.5-flash carries the high-traffic standard tier (fast, multimodal), gemini-3-pro-preview codes on pro, gemini-2.5-pro judges on max, gemini-flash-lite-latest explores on flash. All Gemini models accept images — vision uses gemini-2.5-flash. Requires GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY environment variable.
